title: Renting vs Buying a Home: How to Decide
summary: Ben Felix explains how to decide between renting and buying a home, weighing financial and non-financial factors. He argues that renting is often as good or better than owning, both financially and for well-being.
why: Cited in housing threads for his rule-of-thumb rent-versus-buy analysis and the view that it is often a financial wash.

quote.text: I find his ideas on renting vs. buying to be quite sound.
